messages:
Jordan Lee: Pls escalate. Peregrine Logistics wants an air-gapped POC on customer infra, full BYO-hardware, plus a 25% commitment discount to move forward. Asking for exec signoff and timeline by EOD.
Samir Gupta: Air-gapped eval is doable but it's heavy. We'll need an infra lead onsite/remote, installer package, and a security attestation. Estimate 10 business days to deliver initial build + runbook.
Tess Nguyen: To add: packaging for on-prem ISO + offline installer adds 3 days. We'll also need access to their ops contact and hardware spec doc.
Nina Ortiz: 25% is above my approval band. How strategic is this? Is Peregrine a reference account?
Jordan Lee: They're a global freight customer, potential ARR > $1.5M and strong reference potential in logistics vertical. They want a short pilot to prove throughput with sensitive manifests.
Ava Morales: CTO input: Air-gapped increases risk surface for us (support burden + security). Need a simple risk matrix: required effort, security checklist, support SLA, and commercial concessions. If tradeoff is lower discount + strict pilot scope, propose 12% plus 90-day follow-on commit.
Diego Ramos: Legal: we need to see their IP terms. BYO infra means we must limit indemnities and set clear data handling clauses. Also they asked for source-level access? No.
Samir Gupta: They requested model fine-tuning on their private data during POC. That complicates things: we'd need isolation on training artifacts and a separate pipeline. Approx +5 days.
Jordan Lee: Customer insists fine-tuning because they want domain-specific responses for manifests. They said "no hosted training".
Tess Nguyen: Ops ticket created: INF-20321 for on-prem build + runbook. Assigning to Tess.
Deploy Bot: Created INF-20321: on-prem POC packaging. Assigned to Tess Nguyen.
Nina Ortiz: Can we offer a phased approach: Phase 1 (air-gapped inference only) at 12% discount, Phase 2 (fine-tune) contingent on SOW + extra fee and 10 business days. That buys us time to negotiate legal.
Ava Morales: Agree with phased. Also recommend a support carve-out: limited support hours for air-gapped and no code changes on customer infra. We should require a signed tech addendum.
Diego Ramos: Will draft a tech addendum template with limited warranty and data handling clauses. ETA: 24 hours.
Samir Gupta: I'll sketch resource plan and timeline: Phase1 = 7-13 days (packaging + validation), Phase2 (fine-tune) additional 7 days. I'll post infra checklist and hardware minimums in this thread.
Jordan Lee: I'll update Peregrine with phased offer unless CRO wants to push bigger concession. @CRO please advise — we can close faster w/25% but risk heavy support burden. :wave:
thread_summary: Peregrine Logistics requests an air-gapped, on-prem POC plus fine-tuning and a 25% discount. Technical team: air-gapped inference doable (7-13 days), fine-tuning adds ~5-7 days. Legal to prepare tech addendum in 24h. Ops ticket INF-20321 opened. Proposed phased commercial approach: 12% for Phase 1 (inference) then SOW for fine-tune. CRO asked for final guidance on discount vs. support risk.
